mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_ac_idx = #{followerAcIdx} AND followed_ac_idx = #{followedAcIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(follows_idx) FROM follows WHERE follower_ac_idx = #{followerAcIdx} AND followed_ac_idx = #{followedAcIdx}
SELECT COUNT(follows_idx) FROM follows WHERE follower_ac_idx = #{followerAcIdx}
SELECT COUNT(follows_idx) FROM follows WHERE followed_ac_idx = #{followedAcIdx}

SELECT u.ac_idx, u.nickname, u.img AS profileImg, u.category_idx, CASE WHEN f_reverse.followed_ac_idx IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS followedByCurrentUser FROM follows f JOIN userAccount u ON u.ac_idx = f.follower_ac_idx LEFT JOIN follows f_reverse ON f_reverse.follower_ac_idx = f.followed_ac_idx AND f_reverse.followed_ac_idx = f.follower_ac_idx WHERE f.followed_ac_idx = #{followerAcIdx}

SELECT u.ac_idx, u.nickname, u.img AS profileImg, u.category_idx, 1 AS followedByCurrentUser FROM follows f JOIN userAccount u ON u.ac_idx = f.followed_ac_idx WHERE f.follower_ac_idx = #{followedAcIdx}
